60 likes, 3 comments - assetyogi on July 14, 2026: "Claiming fake HRA by showing rent paid to family members can attract a 200% tax penalty, interest, and even prosecution.

To stay safe ensure the following:

Have a valid rent agreement
Pay rent via bank transfer
Ensure the landlord reports rental income in their ITR.

The Income Tax Department now cross-checks AIS, bank transactions, landlord ITR, and payment trails.

[ HRA Allowance, Income Tax, Personal Finance]

#hra #incometax #assetyogi".
